_comment: Team-builder position map. 'keywords' are matched (spaces/ZWNJ ignored) against the player name part of Kimdi card titles. 'overrides' maps a product id to GK|DEF|MID|FWD|COACH|EXCLUDE and always wins. Edit this file to fix/extend positions. OCR overrides (source:'ocr') were generated offline from the position text printed under the player name on each card image (tesseract); they are static and no OCR runs at runtime.
